label: A being in act whose esse is its essence is CONCRETE_6 and exists at w
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: every being x in act as to being (InAct x esse of the shared q.3 a.4 profile) whose represented esse equals its essence is concrete and exists at the selected world w of the grounding profile (ActualConcrete m w x). It is the converse of the existing-in-act contract 0436de86, restricted to beings whose esse is their essence; the unrestricted converse (every being in act is concrete and exists at w) is stronger and is not stated. The q.3 a.4 profile is world-free, so this reads its actuality at w for such beings; since InAct does not depend on the world, accepting the bridge at every world rather than only at the selected w would make such a being exist at every world, a modal reading not asserted here. On the CONCRETE_6 reading of concreteness (having esse in re, InAct x esse) the concreteness half is close to definitional; the main content is existence at w. AbsentSourceControl satisfies every other input of the first-source-to-root argument without it.
